```regex
^\d{5}(-\d{4})?$
```

This matches exactly five digits, optionally followed by a hyphen and four more digits (ZIP+4). The `^` and `$` anchors keep it from matching a ZIP embedded in a longer string. If you're validating text that may contain surrounding whitespace, trim it first.

This checks the format only. It doesn't confirm that the code is assigned to a real delivery area.
